Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazê-lo [neste vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

Competidores participando pela primeira vez precisam apresentar na competição um documento oficial com nome, data de nascimento e nacionalidade. Sugerimos que você chegue 30 minutos antes do horário da modalidade em que vai competir.

Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, a WCA e seus parceiros utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais.

---

🇺🇸 Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClickClockBrasilia2025/register) tab. If you have any problem registering, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8?si=znioC-4r06ap7Urn&t=410).

If this is your first time competing, watch [this video](https://youtu.be/UHqunxu3rOU) to learn how to compete. Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations) before the competition. Competitors participating for the first time must present an official document with their name, date of birth and nationality. We suggest you arrive 30 minutes before the event you're competing in is scheduled to begin.

By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.

## This competition only has Multi-Blind.

This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). If you are new to competing, please refer to the [Competitor Responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UCSDMultiBlindCooldown2025#56775-competitor-responsibilities) tab.

Spectators can attend for free and can come and go as they please! No registration or check-in process is needed for spectating.

This competition is organized in partnership with [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).

items.name: WCC Western FMC Championship 2025
items.information:
## On the spot registration has opened for the following locations:
* Davis, CA
* Santa Clara, CA
* San Diego, CA
* Reno, NV
* Kailua, HI

If you would like to participate at one of these locations, please [contact us by using the link here.](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/contact?competitionId=WCCWesternFMCChampionship2025&contactRecipient=competition)

---

- This competition is a special competition with only 3x3x3 Fewest Moves; we will not be holding any other event. **We do not recommend new competitors attend this competition.**

- This competition will take place at different venues across California, Nevada, and Hawaii.  Please reach out to local delegates to reach out to us about hosting a location.

-  Check out the [Locations Tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/WCCWesternFMCChampionship2024#52263-locations) for more details.

This competition is organized by [West Coast Cubing](https://www.westcoastcubing.com/) and sponsored by [SpeedCubeShop](https://speedcubeshop.com/).
